text: but just FYI I started the process in the end of 2019. The money we got back I think in 2023....so, it has been some years and things always change in MH, and each one is one and each clerk is a clerk. This one liked us. I was in Hadera. We questioned one day what we needed to do to get it back while we were with her renewing the visa as usual, and she said to write a letter saying why, lot of time has passed etc...anyway...just to tell that I kind of old in the process and  got my citizenship this year. So keep in mind. Just sharing my personal experience. Not sure if this is the rule. Or if there is any for that.
